title: PHP Developer
summary: PHP developers build and maintain websites and web apps in PHP, usually on Laravel or WordPress, with a MySQL database behind them. They often work in small agency or product teams, close to designers, front-end developers and sometimes the client.
dailyDuties: Build features and pages in Laravel or WordPress
Create and connect REST APIs, such as payment gateways
Build custom WordPress themes and plugins
Debug bugs reported by testers or clients
Push code to Git and deploy to the server

skills.expectation: Write clean, modern PHP for web applications
Build sites and APIs on a PHP framework such as Laravel or CodeIgniter
Build custom WordPress themes and plugins with hooks and custom post types
Write MySQL queries and design tables for the app
Build and integrate REST APIs, including payment and third-party APIs
Add front-end behaviour with JavaScript, jQuery and AJAX
Turn designs into responsive HTML and CSS pages
Follow object-oriented and MVC structure in PHP code
Work in Git branches and raise pull requests
Write PHPUnit tests for important features
Use Eloquent models and migrations well
Find and fix slow MySQL queries
Deploy and debug on a Linux server with Apache or Nginx
Keep WordPress sites fast and search-friendly

groups.label: A PHP framework (Laravel, CodeIgniter) or WordPress
